scripts.check: pnpm run node:check && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json
scripts.check:watch: pnpm run node:check && svelte-kit sync && svelte-check --tsconfig ./tsconfig.json --watch
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:build
scripts.test:unit: pnpm run node:check && vitest run src --exclude src/build.test.ts
scripts.test:build: pnpm run node:check && vitest run src/build.test.ts
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run node:check && node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/hub-auth-landing.test.ts tests/hub-avatar.test.ts tests/hub-favicon.test.ts tests/hub-links.test.ts tests/hub-service-controls.test.ts tests/hub-og-image.test.ts tests/hub-seo-meta.test.ts tests/hub-sign-out.test.ts tests/hub-tailwind.test.ts tests/hub-workos-callback.test.ts tests/hub-workos-hooks.test.ts
